summary: INI and YAML inventories support host ranges like www[01:50].example.com, optional strides like [01:50:2], inclusive bounds, optional leading zeros, and alphabetic ranges like db-[a:f].
questions: How do I add 50 numbered web servers without listing each one?
How do I define every other host in a range?
Can I use letter ranges in inventory hostnames?

answer_card.title: Host ranges in inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[webservers]
www[01:50].example.com      # www01..www50 (inclusive)
www[01:50:2].example.com    # stride 2: www01, www03, ... www49

[databases]
db-[a:f].example.com
```
YAML uses the same patterns as host keys, for example `www[01:50].example.com:`. Leading zeros are optional.
